interpretation: Stage-indexed unit layout streams decoded using the record loops at bank 8 $8043, $80B2, and $80F5. Each stage is stored as player deployment triples, group-1 four-byte records, then group-2 six-byte records. The group-2 type byte's top bit sets a side flag. Bank 8 $8030 branches at stage index 10: stages 0-9 use the roster slot IDs in these player entries and set $6813 from the battle header count; their type IDs are joined from the startup roster seed. Stages 10-18 read the runtime roster index from $6807,X, jump over the stage-layout roster byte at $8041, then resolve the current type through $651B. Those entries expose the ignored layout byte and Y/X positions, without assigning a fixed type. The first position byte is world Y and the second is world X; stage 0 group-2 coordinates exactly match the supplied battle screenshot when read in that order. Group-2 auxiliary byte 1 is copied to $67B1 and controls the low-nibble AI branch; all three raw auxiliary bytes are also preserved.
